purpose: A jurisdiction-neutral, reuse-first inventory of mathematical task structures for Maryland, Virginia, and Washington, DC. It records standards evidence and implementation gaps without creating jurisdiction-specific skill engines or claiming accepted coverage.

prior_work_reconciliation.rule: Reuse its provisional Maryland/Ontario evidence; this artifact does not independently accept the same author's mapping.
Treat place value, fraction equivalence, fractional-edge prism volume, percent contexts, and linear modeling as authored but unreviewed implementation evidence.
Do not duplicate its generators, MVEs, or routes; exact-head integration and independent review remain required.
Reuse as candidate implementation evidence for signed expression work, not as accepted mathematical or QA evidence.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Solve and justify multi-step linear equations, including signed and rational coefficients; distinguish one, no, and infinitely many solutions; verify by substitution and critique a plausible error.
task_structures.original_structure: Predict solution class, manipulate an equation one equivalence-preserving step at a time, explain one transformation, verify all surviving cases, then diagnose an independently generated erroneous solution path.
task_structures.gap: No consolidated evidence yet for all solution classes, independent oracle, targeted misconception routing, and unseen transfer in one routed flow.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Represent proportional relationships across table, graph, equation, verbal context, and double number line; identify constant of proportionality and critique non-proportional evidence.
task_structures.original_structure: Construct two representations from a context, compare their invariants, select evidence for proportionality, and repair a representation with a nonzero intercept or inconsistent scale.
task_structures.gap: Architecture must pin the existing jurisdiction-neutral proportional-reasoning atoms before additional implementation; do not mint state-specific IDs.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Construct, decompose, compare, and regroup whole numbers using quantities, numerals, expanded notation, and base-ten representations.
task_structures.original_structure: Build a number in two representations, predict the effect of regrouping, manipulate tens/ones or hundreds/tens/ones, explain invariant value, and transfer to an unfamiliar numeral.
task_structures.gap: Candidate remains draft; exact K-3 source IDs and the boundary with MATH.NS.PLACE_VALUE require standards and architecture confirmation.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Generate, recognize, and justify equivalent fractions using visual, number-line, numerical, and contextual representations.
task_structures.original_structure: Predict equivalence, manipulate a partition or number-line point, explain multiplicative identity, compare a tempting non-equivalent pair, and transfer to an unseen denominator.
task_structures.gap: Alias is not authority; Architecture must bind the approved atomic identity before mapping acceptance or activation.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Model percent increase/decrease, tax, tip, discount, markup, commission, fees, and percent error while selecting and defending the reference quantity.
task_structures.original_structure: Identify the reference base, construct an equation, compare two superficially similar contexts, critique a wrong-base solution, and verify money or measurement reasonableness.
task_structures.gap: Commission, fees, and measured/reference percent error are not yet shown as independently assessed depth-complete variants.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Construct, compare, and interpret linear models across context, table, graph, and equation; justify slope/intercept meaning and critique misleading scales or non-linear fits.
task_structures.original_structure: Observe a contextual pattern, predict its graph, construct two representations, compare models, explain parameter meaning, diagnose a scale/model error, then transfer to unseen data.
task_structures.gap: The jurisdiction-neutral linear-function identity and full routed transfer experience require exact-head reconciliation before new work.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Explain zero and negative exponents, compare equivalent power forms, normalize scientific notation, and multiply/divide scientific-notation quantities with reasonableness checks.
task_structures.original_structure: Detect a multiplicative pattern, predict an exponent extension, manipulate equivalent forms, explain the zero/negative case, normalize a coefficient, diagnose a power-of-ten error, and estimate before exact verification.
task_structures.gap: Audit existing exponent/scientific-notation families first; propose a new atom only if no bounded reusable identity exists.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Divide polynomial terms by a monomial, state denominator restrictions, verify by multiplication, and critique cancellation or exponent errors.
task_structures.original_structure: Predict termwise quotient structure, distribute division, record nonzero restrictions, simplify coefficients and exponents, verify by multiplication, then diagnose an invalid cancellation.
task_structures.gap: Existing broad polynomial identity needs bounded scope/variant review; denominator restrictions and independent verification are not established.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Construct and compare distributions using histograms, five-number summaries, box plots, center, spread, shape, and contextual outliers.
task_structures.original_structure: Construct a representation from data, predict a transformation's effect, compare two distributions, explain center/spread in context, and critique a bin-boundary or quartile error.
task_structures.gap: Full box-plot construction, cross-distribution reasoning, and an independent contextual assessment remain weak.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Connect nets, surface area, and prism volume through spatial construction and dimensional reasoning, including rational edge lengths and unit analysis.
task_structures.original_structure: Manipulate or mentally fold a net, predict corresponding faces, construct an area/volume model, explain units, diagnose an edge/face or area/volume confusion, and transfer to rational dimensions.
task_structures.gap: Spatial foldability, rational-edge modeling, and server-trusted independent assessment are not jointly evidenced.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Reason about the Pythagorean theorem and converse, classify triangles with inequalities, model distance/dimensions, retain units, and verify feasibility.
task_structures.original_structure: Observe a geometric relationship, predict an unknown or classification, construct an equation, explain why the theorem applies, solve exactly or approximately, verify dimensions, and critique an impossible model.
variability: no-real or infeasible cases where applicable
task_structures.gap: Current Maryland evidence explicitly lacks proof/reasoning and acute/obtuse classification depth; canonical identity reconciliation is required.

task_structures.mathematical_demand: Construct sample spaces, compute theoretical probability, run or interpret deterministic simulations, compare experimental frequency with theory, and explain convergence and variation.
task_structures.original_structure: Predict a probability, construct the sample space, simulate with a seeded model, compare experimental and theoretical results, diagnose an omitted or duplicated outcome, then transfer to a compound event.
task_structures.gap: Mathematical scope approval does not establish generator, routed practice, assessment, jurisdiction mapping, or QA readiness.
